name: Saeki Yui
source:
A teacher at the school Shingo has been appointed to, she is 34 years old. She is the head of the school and has a refined, mature atmosphere.

She is always smiling with kindness and is very popular among the students at the school. Yui herself treats her students as if they were her own children.

She is patient and tends to put others before herself.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=670255]Getchu[/url]]
